- SMB SaaS for mid-market e-comm merchants. 75 employees. Looking to add AI-powered support summarization + fast doc search.

- Heavy emphasis on data privacy: "logs/requests retention", "opt-out for end-customers", and whether prompts are persisted beyond inference.
